crossRefs.note: But as for you, only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted it, you take of…
Israel has sinned. Yes, they have even transgressed my covenant which I commanded them. Yes, they have even taken some…
Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh…
Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim…
Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek to Yahweh. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.
In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did…
After these things and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, entered into Judah, and encamped against…
Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence…
I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness…

translations.web: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.
translations.bsb: When you are encamped against your enemies, then you shall keep yourself from every wicked thing.
translations.kjv: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.
translations.asv: When thou goest forth in camp against thine enemies, then thou shalt keep thee from every evil thing.
